goal: Is ke baad aap array declare kar sakte hain, usay shuruati values de sakte hain, index ke zariye elements read aur change kar sakte hain, aur samjha sakte hain ke aakhri index size - 1 kyun hota hai.
warmup: Ek university mein lockers ki ek row hai jin ke number 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 hain. Poori row ka ek hi naam hai, 'Row A', aur aap ek locker ko uske number se kholte hain. Ab socho ke aap ko 50 students ke marks store karne hain. Kya aap m1, m2 ... m50 naam ke 50 variables banayenge? Yeh bohat mushkil kaam hai aur in par loop bhi nahi chala sakte. Is ke bajaye aap 50 boxes ka EK array banate hain. Ek naam, bohat si values.
definition: Array ek hi type ki values ka collection hai jo memory mein ek doosre ke saath saath, EK hi naam se store hoti hain. Har value ek element hoti hai. Aap kisi element tak uske index (position number) se pohanchte hain, square brackets mein, jaise marks[2]. Indexes 0 se shuru hote hain. Size N ke array ke indexes 0 se N-1 tak hote hain. Size array declare karte waqt fixed ho jata hai aur woh constant hona chahiye.
howItWorks: Declare karne ke liye type, naam aur size likhein: int marks[5]; Yeh ek row mein 5 int boxes reserve kar deta hai. Array visual kholein aur index slider ko hilayein. Index wala box roshan ho jata hai. Index 0 pehla box hai, doosra nahi. Is liye teesra student marks[2] hai. Aakhri box ka index size - 1 = 4 hai. Agar aap slider ko 5 par le jayein to visual warning deta hai: marks[5] mojood hi nahi hai. C++ aap ko NAHI rokega. Woh jo memory agli hogi usay read ya overwrite kar dega, jis se ajeeb values aati hain ya program crash ho jata hai. Isay out of bounds kehte hain. Aap braces mein shuruati values de sakte hain: int marks[5] = {70, 85, 62, 90, 78}; Agar aap kam values dein to baaki 0 ho jati hain: int c[5] = {1, 2}; ka matlab 1 2 0 0 0. int d[5] = {0}; paanchon ko 0 bana deta hai. Agar aap braces bilkul na likhein to boxes mein garbage (purani bachi hui values) hoti hain. Values dete waqt aap size chhod bhi sakte hain: int e[] = {4, 8, 15}; compiler khud 3 ginn leta hai. Size constant hona chahiye: 5 jaisa number ya const int SIZE = 5;. Alag variables kyun nahi? Array ke saath aap loop aur index use kar sakte hain: marks[i], jahan i = 0, 1, 2, ... Alag variables ke saath aap m + i nahi likh sakte. Arrays taqreeban hamesha i = 0 se i < SIZE tak for loop ke saath use hote hain. Agle lessons mein hum yehi karenge.
